eccentricredeye: The quartermaster asked Henrik Eccentricred to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Henrik Eccentricred did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Henrik Eccentricred in the open at S-F16. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Edmund Potato of the Hegemony (@boiled_potato31). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Henrik Eccentricred fell at S-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Edmund Potato of the Hegemony (@boiled_potato31).
Bram Eccentricred joined S-F16 under the shadow of Henrik Eccentricred's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
joha123477: Leopold "Saint" Joha signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F4 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. After what happened at the Hanging Bridge, Leopold "Saint" Joha asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.
